firstPlayerRule: Each player draws a tile from the bag. The player whose tile name comes first alphabetically goes first.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The manual does not specify how to resolve matching tile names.
